title: I Left the Hostel Review With the Exact Locker-Beep Interval

parts.text: I slept in bunk 12 and the locker in 14 beeped every 47 seconds from a half-closed latch the desk had promised to fix. I was twenty-six, early train, holding a notes app with 86 beeps. Desk said, "Hostels have character." I left a review with the interval, the bunk numbers, and the time the desk had signed the ticket. Booking replied. Maintenance seated the latch. The next night was quiet enough to hear trains. Character, it turns out, is a latch that closes.
